entities.name: EPS attach result
entities.description: Information element that specifies the result of an attach procedure. It is a type 1 information element with specific coding for result values.

entities.name: EPS attach result IEI
entities.description: Information element identifier for the EPS attach result IE, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Spare bit 4
entities.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero.

entities.name: EPS only
entities.description: EPS attach result value indicating EPS only attach. Coded as bits 3-1 = 001.

entities.name: Combined EPS/IMSI attach
entities.description: EPS attach result value indicating combined EPS/IMSI attach. Coded as bits 3-1 = 010.

entities.name: Reserved values
entities.description: All other values for bits 3-1 beyond 001 and 010 are reserved.

relations.description: The EPS attach result IE contains the IEI identifier in bits 8-5 of octet 1.
The EPS attach result IE contains a spare bit at position 4 of octet 1 that must be coded as zero.
The EPS attach result IE can have value 'EPS only' when bits 3-1 are 001.
The EPS attach result IE can have value 'combined EPS/IMSI attach' when bits 3-1 are 010.
The EPS attach result IE restricts all other bit patterns beyond 001 and 010 to reserved values.
